description: Get what one What's Up In city covers: how many upcoming events it lists and for which dates, when its data was last published, how many sources feed it, and upcoming events per category, topic, neighborhood and town. Call it before searching a city to pick valid category, topic, neighborhood and town values, or to tell a user what that city covers; it returns counts only, no events (use search_events or list_upcoming for those, list_cities for every city at once). No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

city.description: Which city (name or slug): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Atlanta, Cancún, Colorado Springs & Pueblo, DC, Denver, Detroit, Houston, Las Vegas, Mexico City, New York, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Portland, Salt Lake City. list_cities has the full list.
